name: Lazar 3
protection: STANAG Level III base, up to Level V front / IV sides with add-on, mine 3a/3b. Game: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres/engine; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: 8x8 with a high angular hull, side windows with wipers for the crew
Rear ramp with two doors in it, large roof hatches
Roof smoke dischargers; Lazar 3M with a 30 mm RCWS turret
